interface.request: cmd_valid/cmd_ready, opcode 3, three bank IDs and approved 112-bit GEMM payload
interface.response: done_valid/done_ready, operand0 tag, bank_count=3, all three accepted bank IDs and error, held until accepted
interface.layout: activation [M,K] row-major; loaded weight [n_tile,K] row-major; destination [m_count,n_total] row-major with n_start column offset
interface.completion_order: done_valid follows the final successful destination write handshake

numeric.accumulate: K ascending, signed 64-bit shared-exponent mantissa with 32 guard bits; alignment right shifts truncate magnitude toward zero
numeric.output: BF16 round-to-nearest-ties-even; finite overflow yields infinity
numeric.nonfinite_input: return error before the next output write
numeric.throughput: scalar functional baseline; one output dot product at a time

control_rules.dimensions: reject zero and out-of-bank dimensions before any bank access
control_rules.n_tile: writes only requested N columns; no first/accum/last mode or partial-sum read
control_rules.bank_release: executor returns exact accepted bank IDs; dispatcher verifies and releases only on matching completion
control_rules.error: error response keeps original tag and bank IDs; dispatcher invalidates destination on matched error

required_cases: deterministic random BF16 exact-rational golden comparison
pinned checkpoint layer-0 Q projection BF16 activation and weight values in prefill and decode compared bitwise with exact and PyTorch BF16 outputs
odd K across bank word boundary
nonzero M and N offsets with byte strobes
last-token m_start=31 and final 192 columns of 49152-wide logits
destination backpressure and held completion IDs
verification.proof_scope: standalone scalar GEMM executor only; fabric integration, full model prefill/decode numerical acceptance, placed/routed board and Vitis run remain unverified
